lead.headline: First place also holds the first waiver claim
lead.dek: Claims run overnight. AB81, 7-1, picks first. Santa Clara’s Finest, 1-7 with an empty QB slot, picks fourth and needs the wire more than anyone.
lead.pull: The rich get richer. The team short a quarterback picks fourth.
body: The weekly edition has the whole story of AB81’s 1.58-point escape, and it’s worth your time. This brief has a more urgent question, because waiver claims run overnight and the order is a gift to the one team that least deserves another gift. AB81 is 7-1, alone in first place, and holds the No. 1 waiver position. This league runs rolling waivers, a successful claim sends you to the back of the line, and AB81 hasn’t made a claim all season. The franchise that wins without moving gets rewarded for not moving.

Here’s the order: AB81, Poochinski, deeboliciouskins, Santa Clara’s Finest, Cherry Blossom, Maye I touch your TDs?, Big Stric Energy, Bad things man bad things. Now read the bottom half of the standings against that list. The bubble teams chasing the last playoff spot pick sixth and seventh, because they’ve been the ones working the wire. The last-place team picks fourth, with a problem nobody ahead of it has any duty to solve.

That problem: Lamar Jackson is Out with a thumb injury, nobody else on the Santa Clara’s Finest bench plays quarterback, and it’s a two-QB league. The wire’s best names are Malik Willis at 17.48, J.J. McCarthy at 16.65 and Baker Mayfield at 15.43. Willis alone would cut the 29.55-point spread against deeboliciouskins to 12.07. Even in the worst case, with all three gone before it picks, Daniel Jones sits at 14.94. So this front office gets a starter either way. It just might not get the one it wants, and a 1-7 team with a 2% playoff chance doesn’t get to be picky.

AB81’s claim is the fun one, because it needs help too, and more than 7-1 suggests. Matthew Stafford is Questionable with an arm issue, Jalen Hurts is on IR, and that’s the whole backup plan. At receiver, Mike Evans and DeVonta Smith are Out and Carnell Tate is on bye, which leaves Makai Lemon at 5.02 and Darius Cooper at 2.51 in the lineup. George Kittle’s return covers the flex. Ladd McConkey at 12.0 would cover the rest. My call with the No. 1 spot: Willis first, McConkey second. A first-place team with a hole at quarterback on Sunday is a far bigger disaster than a thin receiver room, and AB81 is a 30.9% underdog to Cherry Blossom as it is.

The sleeper in all this is Poochinski at No. 2. It’s the only contender carrying two quarterbacks and nothing behind them, Caleb Williams and Dak Prescott, and its lineup already leads the league at 184.24. It doesn’t need McCarthy. That’s exactly why it might take him. Burning a top waiver spot on depth is a luxury move, but every quarterback that leaves the board before pick four tightens the squeeze. Set your claims tonight. Tomorrow’s brief grades every one.

quick_hits.headline: No stat corrections. AB81’s 1.58 stands.
quick_hits.body: Tuesday’s refresh with Monday’s full play-by-play changed no scores, so Maye I touch your TDs? gets no reprieve and Poochinski keeps its 0.68-point tiebreak edge over Bad things man bad things for second. Only the forward-looking numbers moved. Bad things man bad things went up to 59% for a top-two seed, and AB81 slipped to 44.7% despite sitting in first.

quick_hits.headline: The wire’s biggest name projects for 6.3
quick_hits.body: Adonai Mitchell leads Sleeper at 827,488 adds after his 27.2, and he projects for 6.3. Emmett Johnson is at 363,249 and 4.64. Those are chases. Tyler Allgeier, who scored 36.1 on the wire, is at 520,975 and projects for 10.83, which makes him the rare trending name that actually starts somewhere.

quick_hits.headline: Allgeier is the second claim to make
quick_hits.body: After the quarterback, the obvious add is Allgeier. Santa Clara’s Finest owns Jeremiyah Love, who is Out with an ankle injury, and Allgeier plays for the same team. Blake Corum projects for 7.06 in a flex slot, and two more backs, Bhayshul Tuten and Cam Skattebo, are Questionable. Isaiah Likely (13.37) also beats anything it has at tight end with Hunter Henry Out, but only if the claim survives everyone in front of it.

quick_hits.headline: The champ’s playoff edge survives a shaky week
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? sits at 70.3% and Big Stric Energy at 29.1%, with 53.02 points of tiebreak between them. The champ’s receiver room is the problem: A.J. Brown is Out, and Christian Watson, Drake London and Amon-Ra St. Brown are all Questionable. It picks sixth, one spot ahead of Big Stric Energy. If McConkey gets that far, he’s worth the claim.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things man bad things is stacked, and picks last
quick_hits.body: Eighth in the order and it hardly matters. Kirk Cousins scored 28.18 last week and is a rare rostered player trending up, at 90,424 adds. He’s also starting at 15.7 while Tyler Shough sits on the bench at 20.04. C.J. Stroud makes it four quarterbacks. If anyone in this league ever trades, the call starts here.

w9-m1.headline: Big Stric Energy needs the win and the points
w9-m1.blurb: Bad things man bad things leads 163.88 to 152.91, with a 60.4% edge. Big Stric Energy snapped six straight losses last week. This is where it has to prove that wasn’t a one-off.

w9-m2.headline: One waiver claim changes this spread
w9-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins is a 76.1% favorite, 159.34 to 129.79, against a team projecting with an empty QB slot. A Willis claim makes it 12.07 points. It still won’t be enough.

w9-m3.headline: The champ gets the league’s best lineup
w9-m3.blurb: Poochinski projects for 184.24 and is a 69.3% favorite. Maye I touch your TDs? gets Brock Purdy back and projects for 163.13. The champ needs an upset before the bubble needs its attention.

w9-m4.headline: First place visits the hottest team
w9-m4.blurb: AB81 is a 30.9% underdog, 172.17 to 151.35. Cherry Blossom has won four straight and scored 198.54 last time out. AB81 won’t care. It hasn’t cared all season.

w9-r7-s0.headline: What will Santa Clara’s Finest do at QB?
w9-r7-s0.blurb: The bench has no answer, so this is a waiver decision. Willis at 17.48 if he lasts to pick four, McCarthy or Mayfield if he doesn’t. I’d put in all three, in that order, plus Jones as the floor.

w9-r8-s1.headline: AB81’s Stafford watch starts now
w9-r8-s1.blurb: Stafford is Questionable at 18.77 and the only other quarterback behind him and Darnold is on IR. There’s no bench answer here. AB81 holds the top claim, and this is the slot I’d spend it on.

w9-r8-s5.headline: Kittle’s return fixes AB81’s lineup
w9-r8-s5.blurb: George Kittle at 14.94 for Darius Cooper at 2.51 is a 12.43-point move, the whole gap between AB81’s current lineup and its best one. It has until Sun 1:05 PM, and this one isn’t close.

w9-r6-s8.headline: What will deeboliciouskins do at FLEX?
w9-r6-s8.blurb: Tony Pollard is on bye. We said Rachaad White in the weekly, and I’m walking that back: Malik Nabers projects for 14.42 to White’s 10.32, and DJ Moore (12.64) is Questionable. Nabers by Sun 10:00 AM.

w9-r3-s0.headline: Purdy’s back, and the champ’s math follows
w9-r3-s0.blurb: Brissett projects for 0.0 and Purdy for 22.47. That’s the easiest call on the board, with Purdy’s game at Sun 1:05 PM, and it’s most of the distance between the champ’s 140.59 and its 163.13.

w9-r4-s2.headline: Cherry Blossom’s McCaffrey call has a calf in it
w9-r4-s2.blurb: Jaylen Warren is on bye and McCaffrey’s 22.2 fills the slot, but he’s Questionable with a calf injury. Sun 1:05 PM is the clock. If he goes, Cherry Blossom’s lineup jumps toward its 172.17 ceiling.

trending_notes.8161: Top quarterback on the wire at 17.48. Santa Clara’s Finest needs him. AB81 has first crack.
trending_notes.8132: The trending name worth a claim: 10.83 projected, and Santa Clara’s Finest owns the back who’s Out on the same team.
trending_notes.11625: 827,488 adds and a 6.3 projection. Unclaimed here. A chase, not a fix.
trending_notes.6011: Fine as an insurance play at 10.6. Brissett’s 0.0 projection gives the champ a reason to look, though Purdy solves it.
trending_notes.4881: Santa Clara’s Finest should hold. Drops across Sleeper reached 171,296, but he’s one of only two quarterbacks on this roster.
trending_notes.1166: Bad things man bad things got here before the crowd, and he’s already starting.

external_facts.claim: Waiver order per Sleeper on Tuesday morning: AB81 1, Poochinski 2, deeboliciouskins 3, Santa Clara's Finest 4, Cherry Blossom 5, Maye I touch your TDs? 6, Big Stric Energy 7, Bad things man bad things 8. Waiver type is rolling; claims have run overnight into Wednesday each week. AB81 has zero successful waiver claims this season.
external_facts.source: Sleeper league settings, rosters and transactions API, pulled 2026-11-03

external_facts.claim: Arithmetic: 129.79 + 17.48 = 147.27 for Santa Clara's Finest with Willis, which is 12.07 behind 159.34. Kittle 14.94 minus Cooper 2.51 = 12.43, the gap between AB81's 138.92 and 151.35.
Points-for gap: Maye I touch your TDs? 1238.58 minus Big Stric Energy 1185.56 = 53.02.
